component.name: Clipman
component.summary: Browse, trim and compress game clips

description.p: A native clip browser, trimmer and compressor for game clips, made for GPU Screen Recorder replays that need to fit Discord's upload limit.

ul.li: Browse a folder of clips with thumbnails
Trim frame-exactly, pick and mix audio tracks, and suppress noise
Export with presets that hit a size limit (two-pass x264 or GPU encoding)
